title: My favourite modern NES games
llm_summary: Jordi’s post showcases a curated list of 25 “modern” homebrew titles that push the Nintendo Entertainment System’s (NES) hardware to its limits, proving that inventive developers can still craft fresh, compelling experiences on a console that’s over four decades old. He highlights games ranging from polished platformers and roguelikes to experimental puzzles, emphasizing how contemporary tools and community support keep the retro‑gaming scene vibrant
